---
name: Feature request
about: Propose adding (or extending) something in the template
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What you want

(One sentence describing the feature.)

## Shape check

> Does this fit the **one-owner / many-customers** shape, or does it require breaking that shape?

If it requires breaking the shape (multi-tenant, customer accounts, vendor marketplace, etc.), this issue will likely be closed pointing at the README's *What this skill is NOT for* section. Please check that section first; if you've read it and still want to propose the feature, explain why this case is the exception.

## User scenario

Whose pain does this solve? (Owner — the non-technical mom/dad/aunt? Or the dev forking the template?)

## Proposed shape

If you have a shape in mind — schema additions, new endpoint, new UI surface — sketch it. If not, that's fine, the issue is for discussion.

## Related companion repos

If this work would also touch [`easier-to-read-submissions`](https://github.com/HomenShum/easier-to-read-submissions) (the protocol) or [`parity-studio`](https://github.com/HomenShum/parity-studio) (the design layer), call that out so we can coordinate cross-repo.
